title: Tax Forms
subtitle: Calculation and consultation of quarterly and annual tax forms

modelo303.title: Form 303 - Quarterly VAT
modelo303.noResult: No amount to pay or offset
modelo303.noDeductible: No deductible VAT in this period
modelo303.noData: No data for the selected period
modelo303.infoContent: Form 303 is the quarterly VAT return. It captures the difference between output VAT (charged on your invoices) and input VAT (paid on your expenses). If the result is positive, you must pay that amount to the Tax Agency. If negative, you can offset it in the following quarters.

modelo111.title: Form 111 - Quarterly Income Tax Withholdings
modelo111.description: Income tax withholdings and payments on account
modelo111.retentionsDescription: Withholdings applied on employment income and professional activities
modelo111.noRetentions: No withholdings recorded in this period
modelo111.noData: No data for the selected period
modelo111.infoContent: Form 111 is the quarterly return for income tax withholdings and payments on account. It is used to declare withholdings applied to employees, professionals and business owners. If you have paid invoices with income tax withholding, you must declare and pay those amounts quarterly.

modelo390.title: Form 390 - Annual VAT Summary
modelo390.noData: No data for the selected fiscal year
modelo390.infoContent: Form 390 is the annual VAT summary return. It captures all operations carried out during the entire fiscal year, including data from the four quarterly Form 303 self-assessments. It is filed in January of the year following the declared fiscal year.
